plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent" OR "AI agent") AND ("tool use" OR "tool calling" OR "function calling" OR "tool execution")
queries.angle: Tool use / function calling in agents
queries.rationale: Captures the foundational mechanism most agentic systems rely on for interacting with external systems and tools.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agentic system") AND ("multi-agent" OR "multiagent" OR "agent collaboration" OR "agent teamwork")
queries.rationale: Multi-agent systems are a growing subfield; different agents delegating or collaborating on tasks represent a distinct architectural pattern from single-agent systems.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agentic AI") AND ("planning" OR "task decomposition" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "goal reasoning")
queries.rationale: Captures work on how agents break down complex goals into sub-tasks — a key differentiator from stateless prompting.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent") AND ("agent memory" OR "working memory" OR "context management" OR "conversation memory" OR "long-term memory")
queries.angle: Memory and context management in agents
queries.rationale: Agents that retain and reuse information across interactions (beyond a single prompt window) represent a distinct engineering concern from stateless LLMs.

queries.query: ("agent benchmark" OR "agent evaluation" OR "agentic benchmark" OR "AgentBench" OR "SWE-bench" OR "GAIA benchmark") AND (agent OR autonomous)
queries.rationale: Captures how the community is measuring agent capability — essential for understanding quality bar and comparing approaches.

queries.query: ("ReAct" OR "chain-of-thought" OR "tree-of-thought" OR "chain-of-action" OR "directed reasoning") AND ("LLM" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Named reasoning frameworks are canonical techniques; capturing their latest applications and improvements.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agentic system") AND ("reliability" OR "failure mode" OR "error recovery" OR "robustness" OR "agent safety")
queries.rationale: Practical engineering concern — understanding where agents break down and how to make them more robust.

queries.query: ("agent framework" OR "agentic framework" OR "agent architecture" OR "agent SDK") AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "AI")
queries.rationale: Engineering tooling and framework design — captures how practitioners are building and structuring agentic systems at the code level.

queries.query: ("agent system" OR "agentic AI" OR "LLM-based agent") AND ("production" OR "deployment" OR "real-world" OR "industrial application" OR "enterprise")
queries.rationale: Bridges research to applied concerns — what does it take to run agents in production environments, not just in lab settings.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("prompting strategy" OR "prompt engineering" OR "agent prompting" OR "system prompt")
queries.rationale: How agents are instructed matters enormously in practice; captures work on prompting patterns tailored to agentic behavior.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent") AND ("code generation" OR "software engineering" OR "automated debugging" OR "program synthesis")
queries.rationale: Coding agents are a major application class; this captures research specifically on agents that write, review, or debug code.

queries.query: ("agent" OR "agentic") AND ("web agent" OR "browser agent" OR "web automation" OR "web navigation")
queries.rationale: Agents that interact with web interfaces represent a distinct application axis with unique challenges around UI understanding and action space.

queries.query: ("agent" OR "agentic") AND ("retrieval-augmented" OR "RAG" OR "knowledge retrieval" OR "information retrieval")
queries.rationale: Agents that use retrieval to ground responses in external knowledge bases are a distinct design pattern from purely parametric agents.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent") AND ("reasoning" OR "decision-making" OR "action selection" OR "policy")
queries.rationale: Captures work on how agents choose actions — distinct from reasoning frameworks in that it focuses on decision policies and action selection mechanisms.

queries.query: ("agent" OR "agentic") AND ("computer use" OR "GUI interaction" OR "desktop agent" OR "operating system interaction")
queries.rationale: A rapidly emerging application class where agents operate GUIs and operating systems — distinct from API or tool-based agents.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan covers LLM agents across the full stack of concerns relevant to a practicing agent engineer: core mechanisms (tool use, planning, memory), architectural patterns (multi-agent, reasoning frameworks), engineering concerns (reliability, frameworks, production deployment), prominent application domains (code, web, RAG, GUI), and evaluation infrastructure (benchmarks). Purely theoretical papers without engineering implications are deprioritized but not excluded; the reader's mild preference for grounded work is reflected in the high proportion of queries targeting applied patterns rather than abstract cognitive science analogies.
